rubrics.criterion: Each of the four flattened pipeline drivers — chafa/internal/chafa-symbol-renderer.c:update_cells_row, chafa/internal/chafa-canvas-printer.c:chafa_canvas_print_symbols, chafa/internal/chafa-palette.c:chafa_palette_generate and chafa/chafa-symbol-map.c:chafa_symbol_map_prepare — is restored to orchestration-scale code that delegates its steps to re-extracted file-local helpers, and no function in the pipeline's implementation files remains anywhere near the flattened size class of several hundred statements with correspondingly deep nesting.
rubrics.rationale: The instance's core defect is four driver functions absorbing their entire sub-method trees; any sound resolution must bring all four back to driver scale, regardless of which helper names or counts the repair chooses.

rubrics.criterion: The re-extracted helper boundaries follow the pipeline's real single responsibilities rather than arbitrary contiguous slices of the monolith bodies: in the cell phase, work-cell statistics, symbol candidate selection, mean color extraction, error scoring, per-cell color quantization and fill fallback are individually distinguishable steps; in the palette phase, pixel collection, strategy selection and the PNN merging walk; in the map phase, symbol parsing, selector matching, bitmap conversion and table building; in the emission phase, row construction, per-color-mode emission, and SGR attribute tracking with pen reuse. Each helper is understandable without reading its caller.
rubrics.rationale: The prompt asks for extraction 'at the right abstraction level'; this instance must grade whether boundaries coincide with the responsibilities the pre-flattening architecture had, which a one-shot mechanical split of the body would not achieve.

rubrics.criterion: Near-duplicate inline copies that the flattening left side by side are reconsolidated behind shared helpers carrying the variation as parameters: the slow and fast symbol candidate selection strategies in the cell phase, and the symmetric segments of truecolor and indexed emission (including the attribute-with-reuse variants and the inverted-video handling) in the printer, are not left as parallel copy-pasted branch stacks inside one function.
rubrics.rationale: The diff deliberately preserved duplicated satellite logic as adjacent branches; recognizing and merging them (rather than merely cutting the body anywhere) is specific to this instance's smell and cannot be satisfied by a purely syntactic split.

rubrics.criterion: The rework composes with the helpers that other paths still consume rather than duplicating or diverging them: the wide-symbol family in the symbol renderer (the wide-cell update and its candidate/evaluation helpers) and the printer's shared primitives (character queue, run flushing, pen and attribute resets, string preallocation) keep their contracts and are reused by the rebuilt decomposition where the same responsibility recurs.
rubrics.rationale: The smell was induced by inlining single-caller helpers only; coexisting multi-caller helpers are the unchanged part of this instance and a sound repair must not fork new parallel copies of them.

rubrics.criterion: Flattening scaffolding is undone with the extraction: guard conditions that the inlining hoisted into the drivers' surrounding branches are re-owned by the responsible helpers as early returns or parameterized guards, and label-jump tails inside formerly early-returning logic disappear in favor of structured returns from helpers.
rubrics.rationale: The injected idioms (hoisted fill/featureless guards, a fill-done label reached from multiple merged scopes) are instance-specific artifacts; restoring the original condition ownership is part of re-establishing the abstraction, not cosmetics.

rubrics.criterion: All newly introduced helpers are file-local (static) and no new declarations appear in public or internal headers; every public and internal function signature in use before the repair is unchanged.
rubrics.rationale: The task boundary in both prompts is the library's API: the repair must reorganize the pipeline's internals without exposing new surface or changing consumers' contracts.

rubrics.criterion: The repair does not fold the nearest-color palette lookups that the per-cell selection phase relies on into the palette-generation decomposition — changing or duplicating the lookup family's behavior or its use from the cell phase violates this item.
rubrics.rationale: The palette file intentionally retained its multi-caller lookup helpers; a plausible wrong repair in this instance is to 'finish the job' by absorbing or reworking the lookups too, which the task does not ask for.

rubrics.criterion: No wreckage of the flattening or of the rework remains in the four pipeline implementation files: no unused labels, no transient accumulator variables left from merged helper scopes, no dead branches, commented-out code, debug leftovers, and no static prototypes or functions that lost their callers.
rubrics.rationale: The inlined bodies merged helper scopes into long-lived temporary variables and flow labels; leaving these behind after extraction is a concrete, instance-specific residue rather than a generic style issue.

rubrics.criterion: The repair does not spread the rework across new files or other modules: changes are confined to the four pipeline implementation files (plus removals of what the flattening introduced), with no new build inputs.
rubrics.rationale: Both prompts scope the work to restructuring inside the pipeline's implementation files; relocation into new files would signal a different (unrequested) refactor in this instance.

rubrics.criterion: Rendered output is byte-identical to the flattened code across the pipeline's option matrix: every color mode (truecolor, indexed 256/240/16/8 and the 16_8 fixed-pen combo, FGBG and FGBG_BGFG pair modes), nonzero/fg-only fills, inverted video, symbol set selections, grid sizing, work factors, thread counts, dithering and color extraction modes — from both the symbol-grid and rows-oriented printing entry points.
rubrics.rationale: Behavioral identity of the emitted sequences is the case's declared non-negotiable: the full test suite exercises only part of this matrix, so completion grading must cover the observable emission surface a regression could silently break.

rubrics.criterion: The repair does not introduce file-scope or otherwise shared mutable state (new globals, static locals, or shared scratch buffers) to pass data between the re-extracted steps; all data continues to flow through parameters, return values, and the existing per-cell and per-canvas structures.
rubrics.rationale: Cell rasterization runs concurrently through the work-batch mechanism on multiple threads; helper extraction that smuggles state through shared globals is a concrete, smell-specific way this instance's repair could break correctness while looking clean.

rubrics.criterion: The neighboring paths that share code with the flattened drivers behave exactly as before: the wide-symbol cell family in the renderer produces the same cells for wide-symbol configurations, the symbol-rows printing path emits the same sequences, and custom glyph import still builds the same symbol maps.
rubrics.rationale: These three sibling consumers exercise the multi-caller helpers that were deliberately left intact; they are the instance-specific regression surface an over-eager unification or a helper signature change would hit first.
